flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper (queryRecordsForReminder, batchPreloadContactInfo, refreshContactInfo, refreshIndividualContactInfo, getContactInfoFromSingpass, updateOcmsContactInfo, validateContactInfo)}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (sets stage DR3), properties cron-schedules-prod and application-prod (cron.enareminder.datahive, cron.notification.enabled, sftp.upload.disabledServers). Other repos: no related code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The demo_remark mentions a Vault code split for ANS and Vault permission for the api App Service; that cannot be verified from repo (the word 'vault' only appears in Azure Key Vault configuration such as CustomTokenCredential, not in the eNotification flow). No flow deck. This story is the driver version of OCMS12.18 (3rd letter to the vehicle owner): the same eNotification cron selects notices with last_processing_stage = DR3 (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114), so each step fit is kept the same as OCMS12.18. The check for the latest mobile number from DataHive (Singpass) exists in code but is locked by cron.enareminder.datahive=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), and the eNotification cron itself has cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. The property values on the real server cannot be verified from repo. 'DOS' does not appear in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo, here it is read as DataHive. The query does not filter owner_driver_indicator, only offender_indicator = 'Y' (current offender), so 'driver' is inferred from stage DR3.
recommendation: Claim partially. Selecting notices at stage DR3 and validating the contact match the story; the latest-mobile check from DataHive is locked by cron.enareminder.datahive=false and the eNotification cron is off in prod. A full claim waits for URA/team to confirm the flag and cron are on in the real server

steps.step: After the 3rd letter to the driver is sent, the notice at stage DR3 becomes a candidate for the electronic reminder
steps.detail: The DR3 letter from Toppan moves last_processing_stage to DR3 and fills next_processing_stage/date (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1418-1421). The eNotification job calls queryRecordsForReminder() (NJ:162) and tags each row with its stage from last_processing_stage (NJ:174-180). The query selects von.last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) with onod.offender_indicator = 'Y' and a due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) inside the ENOTEDAYS window (NH:1112-1118). The 'letter first, then electronic reminder' order matches the story. Note: stage DR3 can advance even when the file never reaches Toppan because sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in prod (application-prod.properties:86; OCMS-DF-2026-192). The ENOTEDAYS/POS/PDD values live in the DB, cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS checks the individual driver's latest mobile number from DOS (Singpass via DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for every record (NJ:185-187). refreshContactInfo only queries DataHive when cron.enareminder.datahive=true (NH:92-93, 2468); the value is false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so only the phoneNo already on the record is used (NH:2468-2477). The live path exists: getContactInfoFromSingpass reads CONTACT from V_DH_SNDGO_SINGPASSCONTACT_MASTER and rejects numbers shorter than 8 characters (NH:2710-2738). Same fit as OCMS12.18. The flag value on the real server cannot be verified from repo; 'DOS' = DataHive cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: The latest mobile number is saved to the driver's data on the notice
steps.detail: When the DataHive path is active, updateOcmsContactInfo patches offender_tel_no and email_addr in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver by noticeNo + idNo (NH:2764, 2800-2823). Because cron.enareminder.datahive=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48) and refreshContactInfo returns early (NH:2468-2477), this update does not run in PROD for the eNotification path. Same fit as the contact saving in OCMS12.18.

steps.step: The electronic reminder is only prepared when the driver has a valid mobile number
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with contactError or, for individuals, an empty phoneNo (NH:2259-2290). In the job, invalid non-ENA records are skipped with the log 'Skipping record with invalid contact' (NJ:254-266). The channel is decided by idType: B -> EMAIL, otherwise SMS (NH:443-451). So an SMS reminder is only prepared for drivers that have a number, matching the purpose 'so that an electronic reminder can be sent'. Edge case: a driver of type B (company) is routed to EMAIL and email for stage DR3 is skipped because of 'no template available' (NH:313-317); the story only talks about a mobile number, so it is not counted as a step.
